title: Uniform interior C^{1,α} estimates for infinity-harmonic functions in dimensions d ≥ 3
abstract: A complete Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the main results of the preprint "Uniform Interior C^{1,α} Estimates for Infinity-Harmonic Functions" (OpenAI, 2026). For every dimension d ≥ 3 there are α ∈ (0, 1/3] and C < ∞ such that every bounded viscosity solution u of the infinity-Laplace equation Δ_∞u = Σ u_i u_j u_ij = 0 on the unit ball of ℝ^d is differentiable on the half ball, with sup |∇u| + [∇u]_{C^{0,α}} ≤ C · osc u (Theorem 1.1). Consequently every infinity-harmonic function on a connected open subset of ℝ^d, d ≥ 3, is C¹ (Corollary 1.2). The proof rests on a Liouville theorem for the degenerate limiting equation D²v[(∇ₓv, 1)] = 0 on space-time, for entire solutions admitting uniform affine fits at all scales (Theorem 3.1), which is also formalized. All three results are proved from Mathlib with no sorry and no axioms beyond propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound, including the Crandall–Ishii–Lions theorem of sums and Alexandrov's theorem used along the way.
